notes: Pc uses an empirical element-set error model calibrated on a year of public element sets plus today's measured storm-drag interval; it is not an operational CDM.
Avoidance options assume an impulsive burn and linearised (Hill) relative motion; they are decision aids, not commands, and ignore secondary conjunctions created by the burn.

With public element-set uncertainty (often several km along-track after a day), the burn needed to reach the target Pc can be large; operationally this is the point at which an operator requests better tracking or its own ephemeris before deciding.
